wealth.name: Glyph Wealth
wealth.title: Glyph Wealth | Net worth, spending and holdings in files you own
wealth.description: Glyph Wealth keeps accounts, spending, holdings and net worth as plain lines in your vault. Say a balance or bring in a statement. No bank login, and it never invents a number. Free for Mac and iPhone.
wealth.lead: Accounts, spending, holdings and net worth.
wealth.note: Every figure shown is made up for the pictures. Arithmetic on the numbers you give it, not financial advice. Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later.

imgs.alt: Today on the Mac: net worth counted, what is liquid and owed, an estimate left out of the figure, eighteen months of history and how long the money lasts
Accounts on the Mac, grouped as cash, investments, retirement, property and cards, each with when it was last read
Cash flow on the Mac: what a month costs, how much was kept, each month in, out and kept, and where the month went
Portfolio on the Mac: what is invested, the fees a year, and each holding's share
Scenarios on the Mac: months of runway if work stopped, the number to reach and the year it is reached under a poor, a normal and a good run
Glyph Wealth on iPhone: today's net worth with history and runway
Accounts on iPhone, grouped, each with its balance and when it was read
Cash flow on iPhone: a month's cost and each month in, out and kept
Portfolio on iPhone: invested, fees a year and each holding's share

features: It never invents a number
Every figure traces to a line you said or a file you brought in. What is not known says so, and is never shown as a zero.
Three kinds of certainty
Read from a statement, sourced from a note, or claimed. Totals add only the first two; an estimate is shown beside them, outside the figure.
Say it
Say a balance, a spend or a transfer in plain words. It reads the amount, the account and the date, and keeps your words beside what it understood.
Bring in a statement
CSV, OFX and QFX files. It shows the rows it read, the ones it already had and the ones it skipped, and says so when a file cannot be read.
No bank login
Nothing here holds a password to your bank. Numbers arrive by voice, by a file, or by confirming what a note in your vault already says.
Cash flow
What a month costs, how much of it does not stop, what was kept, and the charges that come back.
Portfolio
What is invested, the fees it costs each year and over ten, and when more than a fifth sits in one holding.
Scenarios
How many months the money lasts if work stopped, the number you are aiming at, and the year it is reached on a poor, a normal and a good run.
Papers and dates
The documents a tax year usually needs, ticked off as they arrive, and the dates that do not move.
Plain lines in your vault
Whole cents, one line per fact, append only. Each device writes its own file, so a synced folder never conflicts.
Tags
The same tags as the rest of the Glyph family, read from one register in your vault.
Mac and iPhone
The same screens on both, saved to the same vault.
